people.her: a young woman with long damp dark red hair, in revealing steel plate armour: round steel pauldrons, a steel breastplate cut low, bare midriff, a short plated skirt, bare thighs and steel greaves; a corked water flask on a cord round her wrist
people.dawn: first light at dawn in a pine wood by a river, low gold sun from the east raking through the trunks, frost on everything

A1.prompt: low shot at water level looking up the river toward the far bank at grey dawn: {her} wading up out of the shallow ford toward camera onto the frosted near bank, water running off her, her wet steel greaves stepping out of the water; stepping stones across the river; pines beyond

A2.prompt: extreme long shot up into tall pines at sunrise: the tops of the pines turning gold one by one from the east, the light coming down the trunks, a pale violet sky with the last stars

A3.prompt: medium shot side-on: {her} standing on a frosted riverbank in {dawn}, the first sunlight reaching her face and shoulders, eyes closing against it, tired; the river behind

A4.prompt: medium long shot tilting down {her} standing on the frosted bank: glowing ember-red light running down her legs like water and soaking into the frosted earth at her feet, the red light pooling and sinking into the ground; her sword point down at her side; the river behind; {dawn}

A5.prompt: close-up of {her} in low gold dawn sunlight, colour returning to her face, breathing out a long white plume of breath smoke into the cold air and watching it; a square stone pillar with a pale dying flame behind her; pines in shade

A6.prompt: medium close-up of {her} lifting the small corked flask on the cord at her wrist and pulling the cork with her teeth, stopping to smell the river water in it, nose wrinkling; a square stone pillar with a pale flame and the river behind; dawn light

A7.prompt: close-up of {her} face, very still, eyes unfocused and searching inward, trying to remember a face and not finding it; soft gold dawn light, pines behind

A8.prompt: long shot from behind {her} walking away up a dirt road through a pine wood toward the light, a stone town gate with battlements open at the top of the road, long shadows on the frost
